entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... David. I'm hoping you can help. I bought this jersey a while back and I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly try to help with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A fault? No, it's just... I think it's the wrong size. I tried it on and it's much too tight in the shoulders. I was looking online for how to do an exchange, but all the rules were so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can definitely help you with that. Getting the right fit is important. Let me just pull up your order to check the details. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, thank goodness. Yes, hold on... it's VF-774-901.
Thank you. Let me see... Okay, I have the order for the VeloFit Pro Aero Jersey, delivered 42 days ago. Let me just quickly confirm the policy for you.
Okay... I hope I'm not too late.
Not at all. Since this is a standard apparel item, it falls under our 90-day return policy. You are well within the window to make a return or an exchange.
Really? That's wonderful! Oh, what a relief. So I can get a bigger size?

Absolutely. I can process that for you right now. I'm sending an email to you as we speak with a pre-paid return label. Just print that out, send the original jersey back to us, and we'll ship out the new size as soon as we receive it.
That's perfect. You've made this so much easier than the website. Thank you, David!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit.
